categories.name: docs
categories.evidence: Changes are entirely documentation, help text, and release notes clarifying the private broadcast feature.
categories.rationale: Corrects overstated privacy claims in documentation and help text that could mislead users regarding privacy guarantees. As author instagibbs states, 'Some of the claims were too strong, so I reframed these in terms of risk reduction, hopefully making user expectations more aligned with what's done'.

categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the 'Private Broadcast' label and updates user-facing text for a P2P relay feature.
categories.rationale: Does not alter P2P network behavior, message handling, or relay logic. The change is restricted to clarifying privacy documentation and marking the feature experimental in help texts.
